title: Waymo Unveils Silver Ojai With Improved Interior as China-Built Fleet Grows
source_used: Waymo company post "From the road, October 6, 2026"
key_facts: Waymo is adding a new version of its Ojai vehicle with a silver exterior.
Interior updates: soft leatherette seating, matching seatbelts, carpeted flooring, high-contrast trim, wireless phone charger, new seats and rear armrests.
It is ramping production at Waymo’s Mesa, Arizona driver integration plant and is on the road for testing.
In the coming weeks it will serve rides in San Francisco, Los Angeles and Las Vegas, then more cities.
quote_evidence: The silver Ojai is ramping up production at our Mesa, AZ driver integration plant and hitting the road for testing now.
In the coming weeks, it will begin serving rides in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Las Vegas before scaling to many more cities over time.
why_it_matters_hint: Waymo’s fleet gets a refreshed cabin; the update is mostly comfort.
notes: Electric Vehicles page blocked (403); Waymo post read instead. The “China-built fleet grows” part of the Electric Vehicles headline is not in Waymo’s post and is not repeated here.
